text:
The door, open.

She came quiet and soft.

Neither matter nor spirit. She brought

a slight leaning of a ship

and a morning light of clear day.


She was not rhythm, she was not harmony

nor color. The heart knows it,

but I could not say how she was,

because she is not form, nor can form contain her.


Tongue, mortal clay, inept chisel,

leave intact the flower of the concept

on this clear night of my wedding,


and sing gently, humbly,

the sensation, the shadow, the accident,

while she fills my whole soul.

translation.title: The Door, Open...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the mystical arrival as something the heart knows but language cannot shape.
